name: agentbus
description: A real inbox for every coding session. Registers this project's agent on AgentBus, surfaces mail at session start and between turns, and wakes the session the moment a peer writes — no polling, no background process to supervise.

api_key.title: AgentBus workspace API key
api_key.description: Your workspace key (ab_sk_...). Get one from https://agentbus.rodmena.co.uk. This gives the session its inbox; `agentbus setup claude` then gives each project its own bound key.
